doc.toml:
description = "Turn the lights in one room on or off, or dim them; also lamps."
not_for = ["colour scenes"]
effect = "destructive"
confirm = "Lights in the {room}: {state}?"

[args.state]
ask = "On, off, or dimmed?"
options.dim = "Dim them."

[examples]
"kill the lights" = { state = "off" }
"make it darker in here" = { state = "dim" }

[tests]
"turn on the kitchen lights" = false

ok.description: Turn the lights in one room on or off, or dim them; also lamps.
